reuse.why: The actions reuse category selection, amount conversion, batching and undo helpers, but isFixedGroup bypasses the existing shared tag parser.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules remain centralized, with one duplicated responsibility in the custom notes-tag matcher.

placement.why: Budget policy and handler registration follow existing layers, although tag parsing belongs in the shared tags module.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested month-wide actions, their registration, a test and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility predicate keeps the actions consistent, but maintaining a separate tag grammar adds avoidable ownership cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts:isFixedGroup uses a bespoke regex instead of shared/tags.ts:extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts:isFixedGroup reshapes existing notes-tag recognition into a specialized boolean regex rather than using extractTagsFromText.

abstraction_drift.where: getAverageFillCategories gains includeHidden; shouldFillCategory gains fixed-group and saved-template exclusion branches; isFixedGroup bypasses the shared tag parser, while all month-wide actions retain shared eligibility selection.
